mainEntity.name: What information do I need before getting a custom trim quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should expect a contractor to confirm measurements, trim style, material, finish level, and any prep work needed before giving a firm price. Photos can help for simple jobs, but they usually are not enough if the space has damage, uneven surfaces, or custom details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have measurements, photos, trim style ideas, and notes about damage or repairs ready. For custom or damaged areas, an on-site look is usually needed for an accurate quote.
